decision: Add a Class B dispatch route for workflow_hygiene (missing job timeout-minutes) limited to .github/workflows/*.yml and excluding compiled gh-aw lock files?
whyItMatters: 38 open workflow_hygiene debts (64 missing-timeout findings) have no dispatch rule, and every existing rule forbids .github/**, so the lane cannot touch them. A job without timeout-minutes can run for the 6-hour default.
evidence: Every open workflow_hygiene finding is rule missing-timeout.
The fix is mechanical but a timeout is a per-job judgement: too low kills legitimate long jobs (the unit gate already takes about 2 minutes, full tests more).
Workflow files are a security-relevant surface; this PR did not edit any.

Founder final rulings, 2026-11-06, relayed to the Steward owner (Opus) for #2283 (verbatim): "Yep its A. I do think most timeouts are related to cloudflare. Please research and check if its the culprit."

Ruling as applied: Option A: narrow Class B route for missing job timeout-minutes limited to .github/workflows/*.yml, excluding generated gh-aw lock files; values chosen from job semantics and historical durations; .github/** stays forbidden for every other repair kind; independent verification and normal CI. The 38 debts / 64 findings are configuration findings, not proof of runtime timeouts. Separately investigate whether Cloudflare deploys cause actual timeout failures (cf-pr-preview.yml Wrangler deploy; sync-artifacts.yml reference to a cloudflare-deploy.yml not found at the expected path); attribute to Cloudflare only on actual run evidence.
recommended: Option A: narrow Class B route for missing job timeout-minutes limited to .github/workflows/*.yml, excluding generated gh-aw lock files; values chosen from job semantics and historical durations; .github/** stays forbidden for every other repair kind; independent verification and normal CI. The 38 debts / 64 findings are configuration findings, not proof of runtime timeouts. Separately investigate whether Cloudflare deploys cause actual timeout failures (cf-pr-preview.yml Wrangler deploy; sync-artifacts.yml reference to a cloudflare-deploy.yml not found at the expected path); attribute to Cloudflare only on actual run evidence.
alternative: Leave workflow timeouts to ordinary reviewed PRs and downgrade the sensor to report-only.
unblocks: Closure of up to 38 debts and a reusable path for workflow hygiene repairs.
